description: M6 recovery case: a well-paired conversation whose post-pre-flight serialized size exceeds the 600,000-char oversized gate
origin_note: Synthetic, not captured: an oversized well-paired conversation does not occur in a real Claude Code session on demand, and design section 7.1's real-not-synthetic rationale does not apply to it. The size is constructed: a small hand-written core (the system prompt and the turn skeleton) padded with deterministic filler to clear the 600,000-character oversized gate measured on this committed artifact. The KBR-5 correction applies: a well-paired conversation is what the M6 recovery path can act on, because an oversized orphan tool result is truncated to a stub before pairing validation runs and the recovery is never reached. The mandatory human-review step is replaced by code-review of the builder (this script), the scrubber's full-byte scan in CI, and a bounded head/tail human read of the committed .body file, per TEST_SUITE.md section 7.1.1.
